verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
lines: A wise son makes a glad father;
but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

verses.text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
lines: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing,
but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.text: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
lines: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry,
but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

verses.text: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
lines: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand,
but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

verses.text: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
lines: He who gathers in summer is a wise son,
but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

verses.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
lines: Blessings are on the head of the righteous,
but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.text: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
lines: The memory of the righteous is blessed,
but the name of the wicked will rot.

verses.text: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
lines: The wise in heart accept commandments,
but a chattering fool will fall.

verses.text: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
lines: He who walks blamelessly walks surely,
but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

verses.text: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
lines: One winking with the eye causes sorrow,
but a chattering fool will fall.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
lines: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life,
but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
lines: Hatred stirs up strife,
but love covers all wrongs.

verses.text: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
lines: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment,
but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

verses.text: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
lines: Wise men lay up knowledge,
but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

verses.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
lines: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city.
The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

verses.text: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
lines: The labor of the righteous leads to life.
The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

verses.text: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
lines: He is in the way of life who heeds correction,
but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

verses.text: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
lines: He who hides hatred has lying lips.
He who utters a slander is a fool.

verses.text: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
lines: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience,
but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

verses.text: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
lines: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver.
The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

verses.text: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
lines: The lips of the righteous feed many,
but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

verses.text: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
lines: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth,
and he adds no trouble to it.

verses.text: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
lines: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness,
but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

verses.text: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
lines: What the wicked fear, will overtake them,
but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

verses.text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
lines: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more;
but the righteous stand firm forever.

verses.text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
lines: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes,
so is the sluggard to those who send him.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
lines: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days,
but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.text: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
lines: The prospect of the righteous is joy,
but the hope of the wicked will perish.

verses.text: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
lines: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright,
but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

verses.text: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
lines: The righteous will never be removed,
but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
lines: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom,
but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

verses.text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
lines: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable,
but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
